lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, thanks for taking my call. Is now a good time?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, I have a few minutes. I filled in your form last week.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. What made you get in touch with us?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: We are comparing a few options. How much does it cost?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: It depends on what you need. Can I ask a couple of questions first?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Sure. Honestly it sounds expensive, and I am not sure we need it right now.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I understand. What would have to be true for this to be worth it for you?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Can you send me something in writing so I can show my manager?
